A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Start with
the right questions.

Have something else in mind?
Speak with the SAFORA team →

What is SAFORA?+

SAFORA is a cybersecurity command center that brings security posture, exposure, cloud, identity and control validation into a shared workspace. It helps teams move from a high-level summary to the findings and evidence behind it.

Who is the platform designed for?+

SAFORA is designed for security teams investigating findings and coverage gaps, and for leaders who need a consistent view of organizational cyber risk.

Can we see the platform in action?+

Yes. Email support@safora.ai to request a walkthrough and discuss your environment. The interactive preview on this page uses illustrative data; a walkthrough can cover the current product in more detail.

Does the preview use live security data?+

No. This website contains a browser-local demonstration with illustrative findings and scores. The current product uses seeded integration data. Production data connections and remediation integrations should be discussed with the team for your specific use case.
